# Seed starting under lights

## The rig in the spare room

Old two-shelf metal rack from Alfie's student flat. Top shelf: the heat mat and the propagator lids. Bottom shelf: pricking-out trays. Lights are a pair of 54 W T5 tubes I took out of the school art room when they refitted it in 2019 (with permission, Mrs Baxter signed for it), plus the new panel from January 2025, see [[Grow light buying notes]] for the saga of choosing that.

Timer plug set 6 am to 8 pm, so 14 hours on.

## Heat mat settings

Thermostat on the mat is a cheap one, so I checked its probe against my good kitchen thermometer the same way as in [[Oven thermometer calibration]]. It reads 1.5°C high. So:

- Peppers and chillies: set to 26°C (really 24.5) until germination, then off
- Tomatoes: 21°C
- Aubergines: 27°C, they sulk otherwise
- Brassicas and lettuce: no mat at all

The 'Hungarian Hot Wax' chillies took 11 days at 26°C. At 21°C in 2024 they took 23 days and half never came.

## Distance and legginess

T5 tubes 5 cm above the seedlings, raised by a notch every few days with the chain. Seedlings under the new panel were held at 30 cm. The 2024 tomatoes on the windowsill were leggy and flopping by week three; under the tubes in 2025 they are short and dark and sturdy. Brushed them with a sheet of card twice a day too, Derek Yeo's trick.

## 2025 sowing log

- 2 Feb: chillies 'Hungarian Hot Wax', 'Padron', 18 cells
- 9 Feb: aubergine 'Black Beauty', 6 cells
- 2 Mar: tomatoes 'Crimson Crush', 'Lizzano', 'Primabella', 'Sungold' (blight-resistant line-up after [[Tomato blight]])
- 16 Mar: brassicas and lettuce in modules, no heat

## Electricity

The tubes plus panel plus mat come to about 190 W for 14 hours, call it 2.7 kWh a day, around 66p a day at 24.5p per unit. Eight weeks of it is about £37. Still cheaper than buying plants at the garden centre in May.
